data.body: AC-AMENDMENT (gap-analysis): test_unassign_issue_wire_format must assert ALL of: (1) method == PUT, (2) URL ends with /rest/api/3/issue/{key}/assignee, (3) body parsed as JSON == {'accountId': None} (structural comparison), (4) NOT wrapped in {'value': ...}, (5) Content-Type == 'application/json'. Also add negative test: unassign_issue raises HTTPError -> handle_create_event logs warning + writes BRIDGE_ALERT (does not crash).
